purpose: Test whether observable market movement since a strictly-prior sale of the exact NFT improves the own-sale anchor, before fitting another estimator

marketIndex.observations: Every verified historical sale in the frozen Dune plus inventory join; no target price or realized target venue is an index routing feature
marketIndex.window: The 28 complete UTC days before each reference day, excluding the reference day and all later sales
marketIndex.distribution: 90th percentile of historical log USD sale price; use global and exact username length buckets 1-4, 5-7, 8-32
marketIndex.histogram: Deterministic log-USD bins width 0.025 from -10 inclusive to 20 exclusive, reporting clipped observation count
marketIndex.priorOwnTimestamp: target event time minus the audited prior-own age in days, rounded to the nearest millisecond
marketIndex.adjustedAnchor: prior-own USD price times exp(target trailing-log-quantile minus prior-own trailing-log-quantile); no floor or live quote
marketIndex.missingIndex: Abstain from adjusted-anchor diagnostic; retain the case in full-attempt denominators

reporting.uncertainty: 2000 deterministic exact-NFT-cluster bootstrap resamples for adjusted versus raw own-sale secondary-premium MALE on common cases
reporting.intervals: No interval is fitted in this signal diagnostic; a qualifying estimator must later report interval coverage and score separately

decision: This exposed-history signal diagnostic cannot qualify production. If neither adjusted anchor improves secondary-premium point error and its lower clustered improvement bound is positive while limiting ordinary deterioration to 5%, reject market indexing as the next feature path. If promising, predeclare and evaluate a separate full estimator with intervals and same-case v25 before any integration.
